title: 去四川看奶奶
summary: A trip to Sichuan to visit grandma, from the early morning departure to the warm hello at the end of the journey.

sentences.text: 今天我和妈妈去四川看奶奶。
sentences.pinyin: Jīn tiān wǒ hé māma qù Sìchuān kàn nǎinai.
sentences.english: Today my mom and I go to Sichuan to visit grandma.

sentences.text: 我很高兴，因为我很爱奶奶，也很想她。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hěn gāoxìng, yīnwèi wǒ hěn ài nǎinai.
sentences.english: I am very happy because I love grandma very much.

sentences.text: 早上我们起得很早。
sentences.pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒmen qǐ de hěn zǎo.
sentences.english: We get up very early in the morning.

sentences.text: 妈妈说：“我们早点走吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Māma shuō: "Wǒmen zǎodiǎn zǒu ba."
sentences.english: Mom says, 'Let's leave a little early.'

sentences.text: 不然人很多。
sentences.pinyin: Bùrán rén hěn duō.
sentences.english: Otherwise, there will be a lot of people.

sentences.text: 我说：“好，我们坐车去吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Hǎo, wǒmen zuò chē qù ma?"
sentences.english: I say, 'Okay, are we taking a bus?'

sentences.text: 妈妈说：“对，我们坐车去。”
sentences.pinyin: Māma shuō: "Duì, wǒmen zuò chē qù."
sentences.english: Mom says, 'Yes, we are going by bus.'

sentences.text: 我拿了一个小包，里面有水和一点吃的。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ ná le yí ge xiǎo bāo, lǐmiàn yǒu shuǐ hé yì diǎn chī de.
sentences.english: I took a small bag with water and a little food inside.

sentences.text: 我在想奶奶现在在做什么。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zài xiǎng nǎinai xiànzài zài zuò shénme.
sentences.english: I am thinking about what grandma is doing now.

sentences.text: 妈妈看着我说：“你很想她吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Māma kànzhe wǒ shuō: "Nǐ hěn xiǎng tā ma?"
sentences.english: Mom looks at me and says, 'Do you miss her a lot?'

sentences.text: 我说：“是的，我很想她。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Shì de, wǒ hěn xiǎng tā."
sentences.english: I say, 'Yes, I miss her very much.'

title: 在车上
summary: A long bus ride where the mountains, water, and people outside the window become part of the trip.

sentences.text: 我们在车上坐了很久。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zài chē shàng zuò le hěn jiǔ.
sentences.english: We sat on the bus for a long time.

sentences.text: 车上有很多人。
sentences.pinyin: Chē shàng yǒu hěn duō rén.
sentences.english: There were many people on the bus.

sentences.text: 有的人在说话。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de rén zài shuōhuà.
sentences.english: Some people were talking.

sentences.text: 有的人在看手机。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de rén zài kàn shǒujī.
sentences.english: Some people were looking at their phones.

sentences.text: 有的人在睡觉。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de rén zài shuìjiào.
sentences.english: Some people were sleeping.

sentences.text: 我看窗外的山和水。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn chuāngwài de shān hé shuǐ.
sentences.english: I look at the mountains and water outside the window.

sentences.text: 山很大，水也很长。
sentences.pinyin: Shān hěn dà, shuǐ yě hěn cháng.
sentences.english: The mountains are big, and the water is long too.

sentences.text: 我说：“妈妈，这里很美。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Māma, zhèlǐ hěn měi."
sentences.english: I say, 'Mom, this place is beautiful.'

sentences.text: 妈妈说：“是的，四川有很多山和水。”
sentences.pinyin: Māma shuō: "Shì de, Sìchuān yǒu hěn duō shān hé shuǐ."
sentences.english: Mom says, 'Yes, Sichuan has many mountains and rivers.'

sentences.text: 我看到路边有小房子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào lù biān yǒu xiǎo fángzi.
sentences.english: I see small houses by the road.

sentences.text: 还有人在走。
sentences.pinyin: Hái yǒu rén zài zǒu.
sentences.english: There are also people walking.

sentences.text: 一个小孩子在跑。
sentences.pinyin: Yí ge xiǎoháizi zài pǎo.
sentences.english: A little child is running.

sentences.text: 他看起来很高兴。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐlái hěn gāoxìng.
sentences.english: He looks very happy.

sentences.text: 我问：“我们还要多久？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn: "Wǒmen hái yào duō jiǔ?"
sentences.english: I ask, 'How much longer do we need?'

sentences.text: 妈妈说：“再等一会儿。”
sentences.pinyin: Māma shuō: "Zài děng yí huìr."
sentences.english: Mom says, 'Wait a little longer.'

title: 到奶奶家
summary: Arriving at grandma's house, with a warm welcome, tea on the table, and a very happy reunion.

sentences.text: 我们到了奶奶家。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen dào le nǎinai jiā.
sentences.english: We arrived at grandma's house.

sentences.text: 奶奶在门口等我们，她看到我们很高兴。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai zài ménkǒu děng wǒmen, tā kàn dào wǒmen hěn gāoxìng.
sentences.english: Grandma is waiting at the door, and she is very happy to see us.

sentences.text: 她说：“你们来了！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: "Nǐmen lái le!"
sentences.english: She says, 'You’re here!'

sentences.text: 我说：“奶奶好！”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Nǎinai hǎo!"
sentences.english: I say, 'Hello, grandma!'

sentences.text: 奶奶走过来抱我，说：“你长大了。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai zǒu guòlai bào wǒ, shuō: "Nǐ zhǎng dà le."
sentences.english: Grandma comes over and hugs me, saying, 'You've grown up.'

sentences.text: 我说：“我也很想你。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Wǒ yě hěn xiǎng nǐ."
sentences.english: I say, 'I miss you too.'

sentences.text: 我们一起走进家里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ zǒu jìn jiā li.
sentences.english: We walk into the house together.

sentences.text: 家不大，但是很干净，也很舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Jiā bú dà, dànshì hěn gānjìng, yě hěn shūfu.
sentences.english: The house is not big, but it is clean and comfortable.

sentences.text: 桌子上有茶和水果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng yǒu chá hé shuǐguǒ.
sentences.english: There is tea and fruit on the table.

sentences.text: 奶奶说：“你们累吗？先坐一下吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai shuō: "Nǐmen lèi ma? Xiān zuò yíxià ba."
sentences.english: Grandma says, 'Are you tired? Sit down first.'

title: 奶奶做饭
summary: Grandma cooks lunch while everyone watches, helps, and waits for the food to be ready.

sentences.text: 中午奶奶做饭。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngwǔ nǎinai zuò fàn.
sentences.english: At noon, grandma cooks.

sentences.text: 她在厨房里很忙，我和妈妈在旁边看。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài chúfáng li hěn máng, wǒ hé māma zài pángbiān kàn.
sentences.english: She is busy in the kitchen, and Mom and I watch from the side.

sentences.text: 我说：“奶奶，我可以帮你吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Nǎinai, wǒ kěyǐ bāng nǐ ma?"
sentences.english: I say, 'Grandma, can I help you?'

sentences.text: 奶奶说：“可以，你帮我拿菜。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai shuō: "Kěyǐ, nǐ bāng wǒ ná cài."
sentences.english: Grandma says, 'Yes, help me carry the vegetables.'

sentences.text: 我拿了菜和水。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ ná le cài hé shuǐ.
sentences.english: I brought the vegetables and water.

sentences.text: 奶奶做了米饭、菜和汤。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai zuò le mǐfàn, cài hé tāng.
sentences.english: Grandma made rice, vegetables, and soup.

sentences.text: 厨房里很香，我觉得很饿。
sentences.pinyin: Chúfáng li hěn xiāng, wǒ juéde hěn è.
sentences.english: The kitchen smells great, and I feel very hungry.

sentences.text: 我说：“奶奶，好香啊！”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Nǎinai, hǎo xiāng a!"
sentences.english: I say, 'Grandma, it smells so good!'

sentences.text: 奶奶说：“一会儿我们一起吃。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai shuō: "Yíhuìr wǒmen yìqǐ chī."
sentences.english: Grandma says, 'We’ll eat together in a moment.'

title: 吃饭聊天
summary: A family meal turns into a cheerful conversation about studying, books, and everyday life.

sentences.text: 我们一起吃饭。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ chī fàn.
sentences.english: We eat together.

sentences.text: 米饭很好吃，菜也很好吃，汤很好喝。
sentences.pinyin: Mǐfàn hěn hǎochī, cài yě hěn hǎochī, tāng hěn hǎohē.
sentences.english: The rice is delicious, the vegetables are delicious, and the soup is tasty too.

sentences.text: 奶奶问我：“你现在学习吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai wèn wǒ: "Nǐ xiànzài xuéxí ma?"
sentences.english: Grandma asks me, 'Are you studying now?'

sentences.text: 我说：“我学习中文。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Wǒ xuéxí Zhōngwén."
sentences.english: I say, 'I study Chinese.'

sentences.text: 我也学习一点英文。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yě xuéxí yì diǎn Yīngwén.
sentences.english: I also study a little English.

sentences.text: 奶奶说：“很好，学习很重要。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai shuō: "Hěn hǎo, xuéxí hěn zhòngyào."
sentences.english: Grandma says, 'Very good, learning is important.'

sentences.text: 妈妈说：“他每天都学习。”
sentences.pinyin: Māma shuō: "Tā měitiān dōu xuéxí."
sentences.english: Mom says, 'He studies every day.'

sentences.text: 我说：“我很喜欢学习。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Wǒ hěn xǐhuan xuéxí."
sentences.english: I say, 'I really like studying.'

sentences.text: 我也喜欢看书。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yě xǐhuan kàn shū.
sentences.english: I also like reading books.

sentences.text: 我们一边吃饭，一边聊天。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yìbiān chī fàn, yìbiān liáotiān.
sentences.english: We chat while eating.

sentences.text: 我觉得很开心。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juéde hěn kāixīn.
sentences.english: I feel very happy.

title: 去市场
summary: An afternoon market visit with fruit, tea, heat, and a lot of people.

sentences.text: 下午我和奶奶去市场。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàwǔ wǒ hé nǎinai qù shìchǎng.
sentences.english: In the afternoon, Grandma and I go to the market.

sentences.text: 市场里有很多人，也有很多东西。
sentences.pinyin: Shìchǎng li yǒu hěn duō rén, yě yǒu hěn duō dōngxi.
sentences.english: There are many people and many things in the market.

sentences.text: 我们看到很多水果。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen kàn dào hěn duō shuǐguǒ.
sentences.english: We see many fruits.

sentences.text: 有苹果。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu píngguǒ.
sentences.english: There are apples.

sentences.text: 还有别的水果。
sentences.pinyin: Hái yǒu bié de shuǐguǒ.
sentences.english: There are also other fruits.

sentences.text: 奶奶说：“这些都很好吃。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai shuō: "Zhèxiē dōu hěn hǎochī."
sentences.english: Grandma says, 'These are all very tasty.'

sentences.text: 我们买了一些水果，也买了茶。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen mǎi le yìxiē shuǐguǒ, yě mǎi le chá.
sentences.english: We bought some fruit and also some tea.

sentences.text: 我帮奶奶拿东西。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bāng nǎinai ná dōngxi.
sentences.english: I help Grandma carry the things.

sentences.text: 天气有一点热，人很多。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì yǒu yìdiǎn rè, rén hěn duō.
sentences.english: The weather is a little hot, and there are a lot of people.

sentences.text: 我说：“这里真的很热。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Zhèlǐ zhēn de hěn rè."
sentences.english: I say, 'It is really hot here.'

sentences.text: 奶奶说：“是的，但是东西很好。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai shuō: "Shì de, dànshì dōngxi hěn hǎo."
sentences.english: Grandma says, 'Yes, but the things are good.'

title: 在奶奶家的生活
summary: A simple daily routine of water, breakfast, reading, rest, and evening TV at grandma's house.

sentences.text: 在奶奶家，我的生活很简单。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nǎinai jiā, wǒ de shēnghuó hěn jiǎndān.
sentences.english: At grandma's house, my life is very simple.

sentences.text: 早上我喝水，吃早饭。
sentences.pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ hē shuǐ, chī zǎofàn.
sentences.english: In the morning, I drink water and eat breakfast.

sentences.text: 奶奶做饭，妈妈帮她。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai zuò fàn, māma bāng tā.
sentences.english: Grandma cooks, and Mom helps her.

sentences.text: 下午我看书，写字，也学习中文。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàwǔ wǒ kàn shū, xiě zì, yě xuéxí Zhōngwén.
sentences.english: In the afternoon, I read, write, and study Chinese.

sentences.text: 有时候我和妈妈说话，有时候我休息。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu shíhou wǒ hé māma shuōhuà, yǒu shíhou wǒ xiūxi.
sentences.english: Sometimes Mom and I talk, and sometimes I rest.

sentences.text: 晚上我们一起看电视。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒmen yìqǐ kàn diànshì.
sentences.english: At night, we watch TV together.

sentences.text: 奶奶喜欢说话，她会说很多事情。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai xǐhuan shuōhuà, tā huì shuō hěn duō shìqing.
sentences.english: Grandma likes to talk, and she can tell many things.

sentences.text: 我喜欢听，也会问问题。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan tīng, yě huì wèn wèntí.
sentences.english: I like to listen, and I also ask questions.

sentences.text: 我觉得这样的生活很好。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhèyàng de shēnghuó hěn hǎo.
sentences.english: I think this kind of life is very good.

title: 四川的城市
summary: A walk through a big city full of shops, people, and interesting things to see.

sentences.text: 有一天，我和妈妈出去走走。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu yì tiān, wǒ hé māma chūqù zǒu zǒu.
sentences.english: One day, Mom and I go out for a walk.

sentences.text: 这个城市很大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì hěn dà.
sentences.english: This city is very big.

sentences.text: 人很多，店也很多。
sentences.pinyin: Rén hěn duō, diàn yě hěn duō.
sentences.english: There are many people and many shops.

sentences.text: 我们看到很多人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen kàn dào hěn duō rén.
sentences.english: We see many people.

sentences.text: 有的人在工作。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de rén zài gōngzuò.
sentences.english: Some people are working.

sentences.text: 有的人在吃饭。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de rén zài chī fàn.
sentences.english: Some people are eating.

sentences.text: 还有很多小店。
sentences.pinyin: Hái yǒu hěn duō xiǎo diàn.
sentences.english: There are also many small shops.

sentences.text: 卖吃的、喝的，还有衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Mài chī de, hē de, hái yǒu yīfu.
sentences.english: They sell food, drinks, and clothes.

sentences.text: 天气很热。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì hěn rè.
sentences.english: The weather is very hot.

sentences.text: 但是我还是很开心。
sentences.pinyin: Dànshì wǒ háishi hěn kāixīn.
sentences.english: But I am still very happy.

sentences.text: 我说：“这里很有意思。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Zhèlǐ hěn yǒuyìsi."
sentences.english: I say, 'This place is interesting.'

sentences.text: 妈妈说：“是的，每个地方都不一样。”
sentences.pinyin: Māma shuō: "Shì de, měi ge dìfang dōu bù yíyàng."
sentences.english: Mom says, 'Yes, every place is different.'

sentences.text: 我们走了很久。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒu le hěn jiǔ.
sentences.english: We walked for a long time.

sentences.text: 看了很多东西。
sentences.pinyin: Kàn le hěn duō dōngxi.
sentences.english: We saw many things.

sentences.text: 我有一点累。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yìdiǎn lèi.
sentences.english: I am a little tired.

sentences.text: 但是很开心。
sentences.pinyin: Dànshì hěn kāixīn.
sentences.english: But I am very happy.

title: 回家
summary: The goodbye before heading home, full of thanks, hugs, and memories that stay with you.

sentences.text: 时间过得很快，我们要回家了。
sentences.pinyin: Shíjiān guò de hěn kuài, wǒmen yào huí jiā le.
sentences.english: Time passed very quickly, and we have to go home.

sentences.text: 明天我们就要走了。
sentences.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒmen jiù yào zǒu le.
sentences.english: Tomorrow we will leave.

sentences.text: 我有一点不开心，因为我不想走。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yìdiǎn bù kāixīn, yīnwèi wǒ bù xiǎng zǒu.
sentences.english: I feel a little unhappy because I don't want to leave.

sentences.text: 我还想和奶奶在一起。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hái xiǎng hé nǎinai zài yìqǐ.
sentences.english: I still want to be with grandma.

sentences.text: 我对奶奶说：“谢谢你，我很开心。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ duì nǎinai shuō: "Xièxie nǐ, wǒ hěn kāixīn."
sentences.english: I say to grandma, 'Thank you, I am very happy.'

sentences.text: 奶奶说：“你以后再来。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai shuō: "Nǐ yǐhòu zài lái."
sentences.english: Grandma says, 'Come again later.'

sentences.text: 我说：“我会再来的。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Wǒ huì zài lái de."
sentences.english: I say, 'I will come again.'

sentences.text: 我们抱了一下。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bào le yíxià.
sentences.english: We hugged.

sentences.text: 我说：“我会很想你。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: "Wǒ huì hěn xiǎng nǐ."
sentences.english: I say, 'I will miss you very much.'

sentences.text: 奶奶说：“我也会想你。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai shuō: "Wǒ yě huì xiǎng nǐ."
sentences.english: Grandma says, 'I will miss you too.'

sentences.text: 在回家的路上，我一直在想。
sentences.pinyin: Zài huí jiā de lù shang, wǒ yìzhí zài xiǎng.
sentences.english: On the way home, I keep thinking.

sentences.text: 这几天的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān de shēnghuó.
sentences.english: About these past few days.

sentences.text: 我觉得很开心。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juéde hěn kāixīn.
sentences.english: I feel very happy.

sentences.text: 也很难忘。
sentences.pinyin: Yě hěn nánwàng.
sentences.english: And it is unforgettable.

title: 旧书里的照片
englishTitle: The photo inside the old book
summary: Mr. Chen is a retired 65-year-old man living in a Beijing hutong. One Saturday he buys an old book at a second-hand market. When he opens it at home, an old black-and-white photograph falls out showing a family of four standing in front of a house.

sentences.text: 陈先生今年六十五岁，已经退休了。
sentences.english: Mr. Chen is sixty-five and already retired.

sentences.text: 他住在北京一条老胡同里，每天早上出去散步，下午喝茶，晚上看书。
sentences.english: He lives in an old hutong in Beijing, where he takes a walk every morning, drinks tea in the afternoon, and reads at night.

sentences.text: 他的生活很安静，也很快乐。
sentences.english: His life is quiet and happy.

sentences.text: 一个星期六的下午，陈先生去附近的旧书市场。
sentences.english: One Saturday afternoon, Mr. Chen goes to a nearby second-hand book market.

sentences.text: 他很喜欢在那里买书。
sentences.english: He likes buying books there.

sentences.text: 那天，他看到一本很旧的书，书名叫《北京的春天》。
sentences.english: That day he sees an old book titled Spring in Beijing.

sentences.text: 他觉得很有意思，就买了。
sentences.english: He thinks it is interesting and buys it.

sentences.text: 回到家，陈先生打开书，想开始看。
sentences.english: Back home, Mr. Chen opens the book and begins to read.

sentences.text: 突然，一张照片从书里掉出来，落在地板上。
sentences.english: Suddenly, a photo falls out onto the floor.

sentences.text: 他捡起来，看了看。
sentences.english: He picks it up and looks at it.

sentences.text: 照片是黑白的，很旧。
sentences.english: It is an old black-and-white photo.

sentences.text: 照片上有一家人：爸爸、妈妈还有两个孩子。
sentences.english: In the photo there is a family: a father, a mother, and two children.

sentences.text: 他们站在一个房子前面。
sentences.english: They are standing in front of a house.

title: 房子在哪里？
summary: Mr. Chen studies the photo carefully and realises the house in it looks remarkably like his own home — same shape, though the tree and door colour have changed. He turns the photo over and finds small writing on the back, but needs his glasses to read it.

sentences.text: 陈先生坐在椅子上，仔细地看这张照片。
sentences.english: Mr. Chen sits in a chair and carefully studies the photo.

sentences.text: 那个房子看起来很熟悉。
sentences.english: The house looks familiar.

sentences.text: 门口有一棵大树，门的颜色是红色的。
sentences.english: There is a big tree by the door, and the door is red.

sentences.text: 他觉得他在什么地方见过这个房子。
sentences.english: He feels he has seen this house somewhere before.

sentences.text: 陈先生站起来，走到窗户旁边，看了看外面的胡同。
sentences.english: Mr. Chen stands up, walks to the window, and looks at the hutong outside.

sentences.text: 他想了很久。
sentences.english: He thinks for a long time.

sentences.text: 突然，他明白了！
sentences.english: Then suddenly he understands.

sentences.text: 照片里的房子……好像就是他自己住的房子！
sentences.english: The house in the photo seems to be the very house he lives in.

sentences.text: 树不一样了，门的颜色也变了，但是房子的形状是一样的。
sentences.english: The tree is different and the door color has changed, but the shape of the house is the same.

sentences.text: 这是谁的家？
sentences.english: Whose home is this?

sentences.text: 他小声问自己。
sentences.english: he asks himself quietly.

sentences.text: 他觉得很吃惊。
sentences.english: He feels surprised.

sentences.text: 这家人是谁？
sentences.english: Who is this family?

sentences.text: 他们现在在哪里？
sentences.english: Where are they now?

sentences.text: 照片的后面有什么字吗？
sentences.english: Is there any writing on the back of the photo?

sentences.text: 他把照片翻过来，看到了一行小字，但是字写得太小，他看不清楚。
sentences.english: He turns the photo over and sees a line of small characters, but they are too tiny to read.

sentences.text: 他需要找他的眼镜。
sentences.english: He needs his glasses.

title: 照片背面的字
englishTitle: The words on the back of the photo
summary: Mr. Chen reads the back of the photo: '1965, spring. The Chen family, Dongcheng District, Beijing.' His own surname is Chen, and he was four years old in 1965. He feels a strange, inexplicable connection to the little boy in the photo.

sentences.text: 陈先生找到了眼镜，再次看照片的后面。
sentences.english: Mr. Chen finds his glasses and looks at the back of the photo again.

sentences.text: 字很小，但是他可以认出来：一九六五年，春天。
sentences.english: The writing is very small, but he can make it out: spring, 1965.

sentences.text: 陈家，北京东城区。
sentences.english: The Chen family, Dongcheng District, Beijing.

sentences.text: 陈先生的心跳得很快。
sentences.english: Mr. Chen's heart beats quickly.

sentences.text: 陈家！
sentences.english: The Chen family!

sentences.text: 他自己也姓陈。
sentences.english: He is also surnamed Chen.

sentences.text: 一九六五年，他才四岁。
sentences.english: In 1965, he was only four years old.

sentences.text: 他的爸爸妈妈那时候住在北京吗？
sentences.english: Were his parents living in Beijing then?

sentences.text: 他不知道。
sentences.english: He doesn't know.

sentences.text: 他的爸爸去世得很早，妈妈很少说起以前的事。
sentences.english: His father died very early, and his mother rarely talks about the past.

sentences.text: 他看着照片里的孩子们。
sentences.english: He looks at the children in the photo.

sentences.text: 大的孩子是女孩，大概八九岁；小的是男孩，大概四五岁。
sentences.english: The older child is a girl, about eight or nine years old; the younger child is a boy, about four or five.

sentences.text: 男孩穿着蓝色的衣服，笑得很开心。
sentences.english: The boy is wearing blue clothes and smiling happily.

sentences.text: 陈先生看着那个小男孩，心里有一种很奇怪的感觉。
sentences.english: As Mr. Chen looks at the little boy, he feels something strange.

sentences.text: 他不知道为什么，但是他觉得他认识这个孩子。
sentences.english: He does not know why, but he feels he knows this child.

title: 去找邻居
summary: The next morning Mr. Chen visits Old Uncle Wang, a 78-year-old neighbour who has lived in the hutong for over fifty years. Wang studies the photo with a strange expression, then tells Mr. Chen to go and ask Grandma Li, who has lived there even longer.

sentences.text: 第二天早上，陈先生吃完早饭，决定去问问胡同里的老邻居。
sentences.english: The next morning, after breakfast, Mr. Chen decides to ask the old neighbors in the hutong.

sentences.text: 他们在这里住了很多年，也许知道一些事情。
sentences.english: They have lived here for many years and might know something.

sentences.text: 他先去找住在对面的王大爷。
sentences.english: He first goes to see Uncle Wang across the way.

sentences.text: 王大爷今年七十八岁，在这条胡同里住了五十多年。
sentences.english: Uncle Wang is seventy-eight years old and has lived in this hutong for more than fifty years.

sentences.text: 王大爷，您好！
sentences.english: Hello, Uncle Wang.

sentences.text: 我有一个问题想问您。
sentences.english: I have a question for you.

sentences.text: 陈先生说。
sentences.english: Mr. Chen says.

sentences.text: 他把照片给王大爷看。
sentences.english: He shows him the photo.

sentences.text: 王大爷拿出自己的眼镜，仔细地看了看。
sentences.english: Uncle Wang takes out his own glasses and looks carefully.

sentences.text: 他的脸上出现了一种奇怪的表情。
sentences.english: A strange expression appears on his face.

sentences.text: 这个房子……王大爷慢慢地说，我以前见过。
sentences.english: This house... Uncle Wang says slowly. I've seen it before.

sentences.text: 但是……他停了一下，陈先生，你在哪里找到这张照片的？
sentences.english: But... he pauses. Mr. Chen, where did you find this photo?

sentences.text: 陈先生告诉他在旧书里发现的。
sentences.english: Mr. Chen tells him he found it in an old book.

sentences.text: 王大爷点了点头，说：你去问问李奶奶吧。
sentences.english: Uncle Wang nods and says, Go ask Grandma Li.

sentences.text: 她在这里住的时间更长，知道的事情更多。
sentences.english: She has lived here even longer and knows more.

title: 李奶奶的故事
summary: Grandma Li, aged 82, recognises the photo immediately. She knows the family — the Chens, a man called Chen Guohua. She says they moved away in 1966 and she never heard from them again. She asks Mr. Chen why he is looking for them.

sentences.text: 李奶奶住在胡同的最里面，一个小院子里。
sentences.english: Grandma Li lives at the very end of the hutong in a small courtyard.

sentences.text: 她今年八十二岁，但是头脑很清楚，记性也很好。
sentences.english: She is eighty-two years old, but her mind is clear and her memory is very good.

sentences.text: 陈先生进门的时候，她正在浇她的花。
sentences.english: When Mr. Chen enters, she is watering her flowers.

sentences.text: 李奶奶，您好！
sentences.english: Hello, Grandma Li.

sentences.text: 陈先生说，然后把照片给她看。
sentences.english: Mr. Chen says, and then he shows her the photo.

sentences.text: 李奶奶看了照片，没有说话。
sentences.english: Grandma Li looks at it and says nothing.

sentences.text: 她的眼睛里有了泪水。
sentences.english: Tears appear in her eyes.

sentences.text: 陈先生很担心，问：您没事吧？
sentences.english: Mr. Chen is worried and asks, Are you okay?

sentences.text: 没事，没事，李奶奶说，只是……这张照片我以前见过。
sentences.english: I'm fine, I'm fine, Grandma Li says. It's just... I have seen this photo before.

sentences.text: 照片里的人我认识。
sentences.english: I know the people in it.

sentences.text: 那是陈家——陈国华一家。
sentences.english: That is the Chen family - Chen Guohua's family.

sentences.text: 陈国华是一个很好的人。
sentences.english: Chen Guohua was a very good man.

sentences.text: 一九六六年，他们搬走了。
sentences.english: In 1966 they moved away.

sentences.text: 后来……我就不知道他们去哪里了。
sentences.english: After that... I don't know where they went.

sentences.text: 她停了一下，看着陈先生，你……你为什么想找他们？
sentences.english: She pauses and looks at Mr. Chen. Why... why do you want to find them?

title: 一个大问题
summary: Mr. Chen tells Grandma Li his name and birth year. He realises his father's name was Chen Guojian — very similar to Chen Guohua. Grandma Li gently asks whether Guohua might have been his father's brother. Mr. Chen doesn't know — his father died when he was twelve and his mother never mentioned an uncle.

sentences.text: 陈先生把自己的故事告诉了李奶奶。
sentences.english: Mr. Chen tells Grandma Li his story.

sentences.text: 他说：我叫陈建国，我也姓陈。
sentences.english: He says, My name is Chen Jianguo, and I am also surnamed Chen.

sentences.text: 我是生于一九六一年。
sentences.english: I was born in 1961.

sentences.text: 我的爸爸叫……他停了一下，因为他突然想起了一件事。
sentences.english: My father was called... He stops because something suddenly occurs to him.

sentences.text: 他的爸爸叫陈国建。
sentences.english: His father was called Chen Guojian.

sentences.text: 国建……国华……
sentences.english: Guojian... Guohua...

sentences.text: 国华是您爸爸的兄弟吗？
sentences.english: Was Guohua your father's brother?

sentences.text: 李奶奶轻轻地问。
sentences.english: Grandma Li asks gently.

sentences.text: 陈先生愣了。
sentences.english: Mr. Chen freezes.

sentences.text: 他的爸爸有兄弟吗？
sentences.english: Did his father have a brother?

sentences.text: 他真的不知道。
sentences.english: He truly does not know.

sentences.text: 他的爸爸去世的时候他才十二岁，妈妈从来没有说过叔叔的事。
sentences.english: His father died when he was twelve, and his mother never mentioned an uncle.

sentences.text: 我……我真的不知道，陈先生说，我的妈妈现在住在上海，我可以给她打电话问一问。
sentences.english: I... I really don't know, Mr. Chen says. My mother now lives in Shanghai. I can call her and ask.

sentences.text: 李奶奶点了点头，说：你打吧。
sentences.english: Grandma Li nods and says, Call her.

sentences.text: 如果真的是陈国华的家，照片里那个小男孩……也许就是你的叔叔。
sentences.english: If this really was Chen Guohua's family, then the little boy in the photo... may be your uncle.

title: 给妈妈打电话
summary: Mr. Chen calls his mother in Shanghai. After a long silence she confirms: his father did have a younger brother called Guohua. They lost contact in 1966 when Guohua's family moved south. His father spent years trying to find him. Mr. Chen tells his mother he may have found a lead.

sentences.text: 陈先生回到家，坐下来，拿起手机，给妈妈打电话。
sentences.english: Mr. Chen returns home, sits down, picks up his mobile phone, and calls his mother.

sentences.text: 电话响了很久才接。
sentences.english: The phone rings for a long time before she answers.

sentences.text: 建国，怎么了？
sentences.english: Jianguo, what's wrong?

sentences.text: 妈妈的声音听起来有点紧张。
sentences.english: His mother's voice sounds a little tense.

sentences.text: 妈，我想问您一个问题。
sentences.english: Mom, I want to ask you a question.

sentences.text: 爸爸……有没有弟弟？
sentences.english: Did Dad... have a younger brother?

sentences.text: 电话那边安静了很久。
sentences.english: There is a long silence on the other end of the line.

sentences.text: 陈先生的心跳得很快。
sentences.english: Mr. Chen's heart beats quickly.

sentences.text: 有，妈妈终于说，声音很小，你爸有一个弟弟，叫国华。
sentences.english: Yes, his mother finally says, her voice very soft. Your dad had a younger brother named Guohua.

sentences.text: 他们小时候感情很好。
sentences.english: They were very close when they were young.

sentences.text: 但是一九六六年，国华一家去了南方，后来就断了联系。
sentences.english: But in 1966, Guohua's family went south, and after that they lost contact.

sentences.text: 你爸爸很想他，但是一直找不到他。
sentences.english: Your father missed him very much, but never found him.

sentences.text: 妈妈停了一下，然后问：建国，你为什么突然问这个？
sentences.english: She pauses and asks, Jianguo, why are you asking all of a sudden?

sentences.text: 陈先生深吸一口气，说：妈，我找到了一张旧照片。
sentences.english: Mr. Chen takes a deep breath and says, Mom, I found an old photo.

sentences.text: 我觉得……我找到叔叔的下落了。
sentences.english: I think... I found Uncle's whereabouts.

title: 去图书馆
summary: At the library's old records department, a librarian finds Chen Guohua's registration: he was a teacher who officially moved to Guangzhou in 1966. Excited, Mr. Chen texts his mother the news and declares he is going to find his uncle.

sentences.text: 第二天，陈先生去了附近的图书馆。
sentences.english: The next day, Mr. Chen goes to the nearby library.

sentences.text: 他想在旧档案里找到陈国华的信息。
sentences.english: He wants to find information about Chen Guohua in the old archives.

sentences.text: 图书馆里有一个专门保存北京老户籍资料的部门。
sentences.english: The library has a department that specially preserves old Beijing household registration records.

sentences.text: 一个年轻的女图书馆员帮他查找。
sentences.english: A young female librarian helps him search.

sentences.text: 她在电脑上找了很久，然后说：我找到了。
sentences.english: She looks for a long time on the computer and then says, I found it.

sentences.text: 一九六一年到一九六六年，这个地址有一个陈国华，职业：教师。
sentences.english: From 1961 to 1966, there was a Chen Guohua at this address. Occupation: teacher.

sentences.text: 一九六六年迁出，地址：广州。
sentences.english: Moved out in 1966. Address: Guangzhou.

sentences.text: 广州！
sentences.english: Guangzhou!

sentences.text: 陈先生很高兴。
sentences.english: Mr. Chen is delighted.

sentences.text: 叔叔去了广州。
sentences.english: His uncle went to Guangzhou.

sentences.text: 他现在还在吗？
sentences.english: Is he still there?

sentences.text: 他打开手机，给妈妈发了一条消息：短信上写着：妈，叔叔一九六六年去了广州。
sentences.english: He opens his phone and sends his mother a message: Mom, Uncle went to Guangzhou in 1966.

sentences.text: 我要去找他。
sentences.english: I am going to find him.

title: 南方的消息
summary: Mr. Chen's mother remembers a contact in Guangzhou. Online research confirms Chen Guohua worked at a Guangzhou primary school from 1966 to 1985. A community website article titled "Old teacher Chen Guohua, a lifetime devoted to education" confirms he was still teaching — Mr. Chen's eyes fill with tears.

sentences.text: 妈妈看到短信，马上打来电话。
sentences.english: After seeing the message, his mother calls right away.

sentences.text: 她说她记得国华以前在广州有一个同学，姓刘，也是老师。
sentences.english: She says she remembers Guohua once had a classmate in Guangzhou surnamed Liu, also a teacher.

sentences.text: 也许可以从这里开始找。
sentences.english: Maybe he can start the search there.

sentences.text: 陈先生记下来，然后开始在网络上查找信息。
sentences.english: Mr. Chen writes it down and begins looking for information online.

sentences.text: 他找到了广州一所小学的旧教职员名单，上面有一个陈国华，工作时间是一九六六年到一九八五年。
sentences.english: He finds an old staff list from a primary school in Guangzhou. It includes a Chen Guohua, with working years from 1966 to 1985.

sentences.text: 一九八五年以后就没有了。
sentences.english: After 1985 there is nothing.

sentences.text: 陈先生的心又开始紧张。
sentences.english: Mr. Chen grows tense again.

sentences.text: 叔叔那年才四十六岁，不会退休。
sentences.english: His uncle was only forty-six that year, so he would not have retired.

sentences.text: 发生了什么？
sentences.english: What happened?

sentences.text: 他继续查，终于在一个广州的社区网站上找到了一篇文章。
sentences.english: He keeps searching and finally finds an article on a Guangzhou community website.

sentences.text: 文章的标题是：老教师陈国华，一生奉献给教育。
sentences.english: The headline is: Old Teacher Chen Guohua, a Life Devoted to Education.

sentences.text: 陈先生的眼睛湿了。
sentences.english: Mr. Chen's eyes fill with tears.

sentences.text: 叔叔还是一个老师。
sentences.english: His uncle was still a teacher.

title: 重逢
summary: Three weeks later Mr. Chen flies to Guangzhou. The article's author turns out to be Uncle Guohua's daughter. The uncle is alive at 87. They meet, look at the old photograph together, and Uncle Guohua weeps when he hears his brother spent a lifetime searching for him. Mr. Chen places the photo in his uncle's hands. Outside, the Guangzhou sun shines warm and bright.

sentences.text: 三个星期以后，陈先生坐飞机去了广州。
sentences.english: Three weeks later, Mr. Chen flies to Guangzhou.

sentences.text: 他在网站上找到了联系方式，给那篇文章的作者发了电子邮件，说明了情况。
sentences.english: He finds contact information on the website and emails the article's author, explaining the situation.

sentences.text: 作者是国华叔叔的女儿——陈小美。
sentences.english: The author is Uncle Guohua's daughter, Chen Xiaomei.

sentences.text: 她很快就回信了，说爸爸还健在，今年八十七岁，住在广州。
sentences.english: She replies quickly, saying her father is still alive, eighty-seven years old, and living in Guangzhou.

sentences.text: 陈先生在广州见到了叔叔。
sentences.english: Mr. Chen meets his uncle in Guangzhou.

sentences.text: 国华叔叔头发全白了，但是眼睛还是很亮。
sentences.english: Uncle Guohua's hair is completely white, but his eyes are still bright.

sentences.text: 他们两个人坐在一起，看着那张旧照片，说了很久很久的话。
sentences.english: The two of them sit together, looking at the old photo, and talk for a very long time.

sentences.text: 叔叔说他一直想念北京，想念哥哥国建。
sentences.english: His uncle says he has always missed Beijing and missed his brother Guojian.

sentences.text: 哥哥走了，陈先生轻轻地说，但是他找了你一辈子。
sentences.english: My father is gone, Mr. Chen says softly, but he searched for you all his life.

sentences.text: 国华叔叔听了，眼泪流下来了。
sentences.english: Uncle Guohua hears this and tears stream down his face.

sentences.text: 陈先生把那张旧照片放在叔叔手里，说：这张照片，应该放在您这里。
sentences.english: Mr. Chen places the old photo in his uncle's hands and says, This photo should stay with you.

sentences.text: 窗外，广州的太阳很大，很暖。
sentences.english: Outside the window, the Guangzhou sun is bright and warm.
